title: ComputeWise: Measuring and Fixing GPU Waste by AI Research Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.31027v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents are given GPUs to do AI research on their own. Do they use those GPUs well? A busy GPU does not tell us, because it can be busy with work the answer did not need. This matters, because the tokens the agent spends cost almost nothing next to the GPUs its experiments run on, so using those GPUs better has a huge impact. So we built ComputeWise, an open benchmark of research tasks on which this waste can be measured and reduced. For it we developed our own simulated GPU, which replays recorded runs to the agent's code. With no real GPU needed, we ran hundreds of experiments, far more than would be reasonable on real GPUs. With no help, the agents put only 52% of their GPU time into work the answer needed. Another 22% went to work it did not need, and 26% sat idle. translated_title: ComputeWise：测量并修复AI研究智能体造成的GPU浪费
translated_abstract: 我们给AI智能体配备GPU，让它们自主进行AI研究。它们能很好地利用这些GPU吗？一个忙碌的GPU并不能说明问题，因为它可能正忙于处理答案并不需要的工作。这一点非常重要，因为相比智能体实验所运行的真实GPU，智能体消耗的token成本几乎可以忽略不计，因此更好地利用这些GPU会带来巨大的影响。为此，我们构建了ComputeWise——一个开放的研究任务基准，可以在此测量并减少这种浪费。我们为其开发了自己的模拟GPU，通过回放已记录的运行过程来响应智能体的代码。由于无需真实GPU，我们运行了数百个实验，远远超过在真实GPU上可以合理运行的规模。结果显示，在没有任何帮助的情况下，智能体仅将52%的GPU时间用于答案真正需要的工作，另外22%花在了不必要的工作上，还有26%处于闲置状态。要求智能体更快完成任务、指示它让每块GPU保持忙碌，或者给它配备作业调度器，都无法解决这一问题。因此，我们构建了一个开源工具框架，其中部分功能（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: 论文提出ComputeWise开放基准，利用模拟GPU测量发现AI研究智能体仅将52%的GPU时间用于有效工作，且提示、并行要求或作业调度器等简单手段均无法修复这种浪费。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces ComputeWise, an open benchmark with a simulated GPU that reveals AI research agents waste GPUs—spending only 52% of GPU time on necessary work—and shows that simple fixes like prompts or job schedulers fail to solve the problem.
